## Post AI tool terms changes to Slack
Each morning this reads the free AI Leakage changes feed (dated, checked changes to AI vendors' terms, privacy pages and pricing, each with a one-line summary) and posts the new ones for the tools your team uses.

**Set up (2 minutes)**
1. In **Your settings**, list your tools by name or slug, separated by commas. The full list is at https://aileakage.com/wp-json/ail/v1/tools . Leave it empty for every tool.
2. In **Post to Slack**, add your Slack credential and pick a channel.
3. Activate. The first run posts the last 7 days; after that only new changes.

Feed: CC BY 4.0, please keep the link back. General information, not legal advice.
